candidates.title: NPU runtime: Hexagon DSP libraries (QAIRT 2.52.0)
candidates.summary: Runtime files for CyanBridge's on-device NPU models on Snapdragon phones. Not an app release. The app downloads only the one file that matches the phone's Hexagon NPU and checks it against the SHA-256 pinned in the app before using it. You do not need to download anything here by hand. File Hexagon Snapdragon SoCs libQnnHtpV68Skel.so V68 SM8350, SA8295 libQnnHtpV69Skel.so V69 SM8450, SM8475 libQnnHtpV73Skel.so V73 SM8550, SA8255 libQnnHtpV75Skel.so V75 SM8650 libQnnHtpV79Skel.so V79 SM8750 libQnnHtpV81Skel.so V81 SM8850 Qualcomm AI Runtime (QAIRT) 2.52.0.261104 Hexagon libraries, used with LiteRT 2.4.0. Checksums: SHA256SUMS , skels.json .
